facts: Chevy's answer to the little Volkswagen Beetle, with an air-cooled six-cylinder engine in the back.
About 1.8 million were built, and there was even a Corvair van and pickup truck.
A 1972 government study found the early Corvair was no harder to control than other cars of its day.
